stages.input: A single-person RGB video in a common OpenCV-readable format.
processing: Estimate person presence and frame-to-frame activity.
Fill short inactive gaps and retain continuous candidates of at least three seconds.
Write each selected interval as a true 30 Hz constant-frame-rate MP4.

stages.input: A 30 Hz walking clip with one principal person.
processing: Run GVHMR tracking, two-dimensional pose extraction and image feature extraction.
Estimate camera motion when the camera is not static.
Recover globally oriented and translated SMPL-X parameters.

stages.input: Per-frame global SMPL-X pose, shape, orientation and translation.
processing: Regress the ordered H36M-17 skeleton and retain left/right toe and heel landmarks.
Attach a 30 Hz time axis in a metre-scale, Y-up, world-grounded coordinate system.

stages.input: World skeleton and measured body height in millimetres.
processing: Stack H36M-17 joints in the fixed order.
Remove each frame's joint centroid and convert axes to the GaitTransformer convention.
Infer gait phase on 60-frame windows and decode heel-strike and toe-off times.

stages.input: World skeleton plus decoded heel-strike and toe-off events.
processing: Compute twenty variability, symmetry, posture and dynamic-stability parameters.
